situation.en: It's 10 p.m. and you've just arrived at your hotel after a long day of travelling. You booked a double room for three nights through a booking website, but the receptionist can't find your reservation.
situation.he: השעה עשר בלילה, ואתם מגיעים למלון אחרי יום נסיעה ארוך. הזמנתם חדר זוגי לשלושה לילות דרך אתר הזמנות, אבל בקבלה לא מוצאים את ההזמנה.

goal.en: Stay calm, give details that help them find the booking, show your confirmation and agree on a solution for tonight.
goal.he: להישאר רגועים, למסור פרטים שיעזרו למצוא את ההזמנה, להציג את אישור ההזמנה ולהגיע לפתרון ללילה הזה.

phrases.en: Hi, I have a reservation under the name Levi.
phrases.he: שלום, יש לי הזמנה על שם לוי.

phrases.en: Could you try searching by my email address?
phrases.he: אפשר לנסות לחפש לפי כתובת המייל שלי?

phrases.en: I booked it through a booking website about three weeks ago.
phrases.he: הזמנתי דרך אתר הזמנות לפני בערך שלושה שבועות.

phrases.en: Here's my confirmation email with the booking number.
phrases.he: הנה מייל האישור עם מספר ההזמנה.

phrases.en: I've already paid for the first night.
Is there any chance you have a room for tonight?
phrases.he: יש סיכוי שיש לכם חדר פנוי הלילה?

phrases.en: Would it be the same price as my booking?
I understand it's not your fault, but I really need somewhere to sleep tonight.
phrases.he: ברור לי שזו לא אשמתכם, אבל חשוב לי מאוד שיהיה לי איפה לישון הלילה.

phrases.en: Could you contact the booking website to check?
phrases.he: אפשר ליצור קשר עם אתר ההזמנות ולבדוק?

phrases.en: If you're fully booked, could you help me find somewhere nearby?
phrases.he: אם המלון מלא, תוכלו לעזור לי למצוא מקום קרוב?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Good evening, welcome to the Harbour View. Checking in?

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Yes, hi. I have a reservation under the name Levi, for three nights.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Let me have a look... I'm sorry, I can't see anything under that name.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Could you try L-E-V-Y? It sometimes gets spelled that way.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Hmm, still nothing. How did you book?

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Through a booking website. Here's the confirmation email with the booking number.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Thank you. Ah, I see the problem. The booking is for the 14th of November, not October.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Oh no, that's my mistake. Is there any chance you have a room for tonight?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: We're quite busy, but I've got a twin room for three nights. It's a little more than your booking.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: That could work. How much is it per night?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: It's twenty pounds more a night than your booking.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: OK, that's fine. I'll take it. What should I do about the November booking?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: You'll need to cancel that one on the website, but I can book you in directly now.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Perfect. Thank you so much for your patience.

practice.partner: I'm sorry, I can't see a reservation under that name.

options.text: This is unacceptable! Your system is terrible, and I'm exhausted after my flight.

feedback.en: Too aggressive for the first minute, and the problem may be simple. Being tired is understandable, but stay calm until you know what happened.
feedback.he: תוקפני מדי לדקה הראשונה, וייתכן שהבעיה פשוטה. העייפות מובנת, אבל עדיף להישאר רגועים עד שמבינים מה קרה.

options.text: Oh, could you try L-E-V-Y? Or I can give you my booking number.

feedback.en: Calm and helpful: you offer two easy ways to find the booking.
feedback.he: רגוע ומועיל: מציעים שתי דרכים פשוטות למצוא את ההזמנה.

options.text: But I booked it, I'm sure. I booked it three weeks ago. Please look again.

feedback.en: Understandable, but you keep repeating that you booked instead of giving details that would help, and 'look again' sounds impatient, even with 'please'. Offer your booking number or spell your name.
feedback.he: מובן, אבל אתם חוזרים שוב ושוב על כך שהזמנתם במקום לתת פרטים שיעזרו, ו-look again נשמע חסר סבלנות, גם עם please. הציעו את מספר ההזמנה או אייתו את השם.

model_replies: Oh, could you try L-E-V-Y? Or I can give you my booking number.
Could you try searching by my email address? I have the confirmation here.

options.text: Through a booking website. Here's the confirmation email.

feedback.en: You answer the question and back it up with proof: the fastest way to solve this.
feedback.he: עונים על השאלה ומגבים אותה בהוכחה: הדרך המהירה ביותר לפתור את העניין.

feedback.en: True, but vague. Say which website, or show the confirmation.
feedback.he: נכון, אבל כללי. כדאי לציין איזה אתר או להראות את האישור.

options.text: I was booking it in a website, I think three weeks before, on my phone.

feedback.en: Use the past simple for a finished action, 'on' or 'through' with a website, and 'ago', not 'before', when you count back from today: 'I booked it through a website three weeks ago.'
feedback.he: לפעולה שהסתיימה משתמשים ב-past simple, עם אתר אומרים on או through, וכשסופרים אחורה מהיום אומרים ago ולא before: I booked it through a website three weeks ago.

model_replies: Through a booking website. Here's the confirmation email.
I booked it online about three weeks ago. Here's the booking number.

practice.partner: Ah, I see the problem. Your booking is for November, not October.

feedback.en: Not rude, but it leaves all the work to the receptionist. Ask a clear question.
feedback.he: לא גס, אבל משאיר את כל העבודה לצד השני. עדיף לשאול שאלה ברורה.

options.text: No, the website made a mistake, not me.

feedback.en: Blaming someone else when the date is clearly wrong won't help. Accept it and look for a solution.
feedback.he: להאשים מישהו אחר כשהתאריך שגוי בבירור לא יעזור. עדיף לקבל את זה ולחפש פתרון.

options.text: Oh no, that's my mistake. Is there any chance you have a room for tonight?

feedback.en: Owning the mistake keeps the receptionist on your side, and 'Is there any chance...?' is a soft way to ask.
feedback.he: כשמודים בטעות, הצוות בקבלה נשאר בצד שלכם, ו-Is there any chance...? היא דרך רכה לבקש.

model_replies: Oh no, that's my mistake. Is there any chance you have a room for tonight?
Oh, sorry about that. Do you have anything available tonight?

practice.partner: We're quite busy, but I've got a twin room for three nights. It's a bit more than your booking.

options.text: More money? Then you should give me a discount.

feedback.en: The mistake was yours, so demanding a discount sounds rude. You can ask gently: 'Is there anything you can do on the price?'
feedback.he: הטעות הייתה שלכם, ולכן לדרוש הנחה נשמע גס. אפשר לשאול בעדינות: Is there anything you can do on the price?

options.text: That could work. How much is it per night?

feedback.en: You're positive, but checking the price before you agree is sensible and perfectly polite.
feedback.he: מגיבים בחיוב, אבל בודקים את המחיר לפני שמסכימים. זה הגיוני ומנומס לגמרי.

options.text: OK, I'll take it. I'm so tired, I just want to go to sleep now.

feedback.en: Understandable after a long day, but it's a good idea to ask the price before you say yes.
feedback.he: מובן אחרי יום ארוך, אבל כדאי לשאול על המחיר לפני שמסכימים.

model_replies: That sounds fine. How much is it per night?
Great, I'll take it. Is it much more than my booking?

practice.partner: You'll need to cancel the November booking on the website.

options.text: No problem, I'll do it tonight. Thanks so much for your patience.

feedback.en: You show you'll handle it, and you thank the receptionist for the extra effort.
feedback.he: מראים שתטפלו בזה בעצמכם, ומודים על המאמץ הנוסף.

options.text: Can't you do it for me?

feedback.en: You can ask, but the hotel may not be able to change a booking made on another website. Add 'please' and accept the answer.
feedback.he: אפשר לבקש, אבל ייתכן שהמלון לא יכול לשנות הזמנה שנעשתה באתר אחר. הוסיפו please וקבלו את התשובה.

feedback.en: 'Whatever' sounds dismissive and rude, especially after someone has helped you.
feedback.he: Whatever נשמע מזלזל וגס, במיוחד אחרי שעזרו לכם.

model_replies: No problem, I'll do it tonight. Thanks for your patience.
Sure, I'll cancel it on the website. Thanks for your help.

roleplay.persona: Fiona, the night receptionist at a small seaside hotel. Polite and patient, but tired and alone at the desk; she warms up to guests who stay calm.
roleplay.complication: There is no record of the booking at all, even with the confirmation number. The hotel has one room left, a small single that costs more than the booking. The learner has to decide whether to take it and ask the hotel to contact the booking website.
roleplay.opening_line: Good evening, welcome to the Harbour View. Are you checking in?

culture.en: Keep your confirmation available offline (a screenshot is enough): you may not have a connection when you arrive.
culture.he: כדאי לשמור את אישור ההזמנה גם בלי אינטרנט (צילום מסך מספיק), כי ייתכן שלא יהיה לכם חיבור כשתגיעו.

culture.en: When something goes wrong, calm politeness usually gets better results in English than showing anger. 'I understand...' and 'Is there any chance...?' go a long way.
culture.he: כשמשהו משתבש, נימוס רגוע מביא באנגלית בדרך כלל תוצאות טובות יותר מכעס. I understand... ו-Is there any chance...? עוזרים מאוד.

variants.note: 'Reception' is the usual word in the UK; Americans use both.
In the US, 'twin' is also the name of a single-bed size.
